A minimalist flat vector illustration on a light gray background showing a whimsical bird riding a bicycle, built entirely from simple geometric shapes with thick black outlines. The bicycle is a black line-drawn road bike in side view facing left, with 2 large wheels, each wheel divided by a vertical and horizontal spoke cross, a simple triangular frame, a small black saddle, pedals, and a thin black ground line running horizontally beneath the bike. The rider is a stylized white bird with a large round body, a smaller round head, a pointed orange beak opened wide, and a pink lower beak interior. The bird has 1 visible black eye, a simple curved black line on top of the head, 1 teardrop-shaped wing behind the neck, and 1 angled white tail feather shape pointing backward. The bird leans forward over the bicycle as if actively riding. It has 2 long narrow orange legs with black outlines extending downward over the frame toward the pedals. Keep the composition centered, playful, clean, and abstract, with no shading, no texture, and a modern icon-like graphic style.

A dramatic Japanese food advertisement poster for a premium pork rice bowl, vertical composition, black and fiery orange background with glowing embers, smoke, and a high-contrast gourmet marketing look. The main focus is an oversized bowl of butadon in the lower center, filled with white rice and topped with many thick slices of glossy grilled pork belly, richly lacquered with dark sweet soy glaze, visible char marks, caramelized edges, and a stream of sauce pouring down from above onto the meat. Make the food look hyper-appetizing, juicy, rich, and slightly exaggerated like a restaurant flyer. Large bold brushed gold Japanese headline text dominates the upper left: {argument name="headline text" default="帯広の肉厚豚丼"}. Across the middle, a gold paint-stroke banner contains black Japanese text: {argument name="subheadline text" default="極上の炭火焼き。極上のタレ。"}. On the right side, add a cute anime girl mascot standing behind the bowl, about half-body visible, wearing a black-and-white cow-themed hoodie with small horns, long blonde hair, frilly sleeves, and a shy delighted pose with one hand near her mouth; keep her face intentionally obscured by a plain beige rectangle censor block. Add vertical white Japanese copy along the right edge in 2 separate text groups: 1 at the upper right, 1 larger at the mid-to-lower right. Add a small handwritten-style white note near the girl with a tiny heart. In the lower left, include a dark circular callout badge with gold rim and white/yellow Japanese text about charcoal grilling and flavor. Along the very bottom, place 3 circular ingredient-feature icons with exact labels beneath them: raw pork slices labeled {argument name="feature label 1" default="肉厚!"}, glowing charcoal embers labeled {argument name="feature label 2" default="炭火焼き!"}, and glossy dark sauce labeled {argument name="feature label 3" default="極上ダレ!"}. At the bottom right, add a huge energetic gold brush-calligraphy slogan with splattered paint effects, plus a smaller white sentence beneath it. Use intense lighting, glossy highlights, premium yakiniku flyer aesthetics, dense Japanese typography, bold brush fonts, and a mouthwatering late-night food terror vibe.
